title: Tanimoto kernel ridge on Morgan counts blended in
spec: Add a kernel ridge regressor with a precomputed MinMax (count Tanimoto) kernel on 2048-bit Morgan count fingerprints, alpha=0.5, fit on y minus its mean. Blend it at 0.25 weight, taking it from the LightGBM share, so the blend is 0.5 LGBM, 0.25 kNN, 0.25 KRR.

title: Tanimoto-kernel kernel ridge on count Morgan
spec: Add a kernel ridge regressor with a precomputed min-max (count Tanimoto) kernel on Morgan count fingerprints (radius 2, 2048 bits). Center y by its mean, use alpha=0.5, and blend it into the final prediction as 0.4*ET + 0.3*KRR + 0.3*kNN. Compute the kernel as sum(min)/sum(max) in vectorized chunks to stay within memory.

title: Larger-radius hashed Morgan counts with chirality-free atom invariants
spec: Change the fingerprint generator in featurize to radius 3 with fpSize 2048 counts, and add a second generator using feature invariants (GetMorganFeatureAtomInvGen) at radius 2 with fpSize 512 counts. Concatenate both with the descriptors. Keep the kNN as is. This tests whether richer substructure information helps with unseen scaffolds.

title: Kernel ridge on descriptors + fingerprint kernel sum
spec: Sum an RBF kernel on quantile-scaled descriptors and a Tanimoto kernel on Morgan counts. Fit KernelRidge with a precomputed kernel, alpha 0.5.

title: Linear-tree LightGBM
spec: Set linear_tree=True with linear_lambda=1.0 in the LightGBM model (keep L1 objective, descriptors only). Descriptors must be finite; they already are after clipping. Reduce num_leaves to 7 if it is slow or unstable. Keep the 0.75/0.25 blend with kNN.

title: Log-transform skewed descriptors plus extra trees linear leaves
spec: Set linear_tree=True in LightGBM with linear_lambda=1.0, num_leaves=5, and with descriptors passed through sign-preserving log1p (np.sign(x)*np.log1p(abs(x))) and then standardized. The linear leaves can capture the smooth physchem trends of permeability better than constants.

title: Local-similarity-gated blend weight
spec: Compute the mean Tanimoto similarity of each test molecule to its k nearest training neighbors in knn_predict (return it too). Set the kNN blend weight per molecule as w=clip(0.5*(sim-0.2)/0.4,0.05,0.5) so close analogs lean on kNN and novel scaffolds lean on LightGBM; final = (1-w)*lgb + w*knn.

title: Log-target-free monotone logP/TPSA prior residual
spec: First fit a Ridge regression (alpha=10) on standardized Crippen MolLogP, TPSA, HBD, HBA, MW and rotatable bonds. Compute the Ridge prediction for train and test. Train LightGBM on the residual y - ridge_pred and add the Ridge prediction back at test time. Keep the kNN blend, applied to the final predictions.
